description: This file defines functions to build configuration objects for BytePlus model providers, including specifying base URLs, APIs, and models. It exports two functions for creating providers for general models and coding models using imported definitions and constants.

methods.name: export function buildBytePlusProvider(): ModelProviderConfig { buildBytePlusProvider
